AI Image in Video — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: instantly insert images into 30-second video clips with simple instructions—no manual editing or timeline required.
- Upload a video and up to three product images, describe placements, and export a ready-to-share 1080p MP4 within a minute.
- Automated session and token handling—no setup required; free credits available for new users.
- Supports quick exports, session-based batch editing, and iterative refinements.
- Compatible with common formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac (max upload 500MB).
- User-friendly error handling and tips included for smoother editing and exporting.
